about: Free fonts found by web search on their official distribution pages (909 fonts). Each entry names the official page it came from; 'license' is a short summary, so read the official page before commercial use. 'checked' says whether the font's own page ('font page') or only the maker's site ('maker site') was confirmed. 'name_en' is the maker's Latin name, 'css_family' the family to use from an official stylesheet that defines several. 'tags' (style: sans, serif, handwriting, brush, display, rounded, cute, pixel, mono) come only from words in the font's own name, the maker's own description or project name (for example NAVER 나눔손글씨 = handwriting), Google Fonts' own category, or our visual check of a rendered sample; fonts without tags were not classified, not judged unfit. 'look' marks fonts that render as outline or shadow letters (our visual check or the name); they are not offered as plain alternatives.
